title: Password changed

tasks.title: Sign in with the new password
steps: Select the Smart Roots name at the top, then sign in with your new password.

tasks.title: Check your two-factor settings
steps: After signing in, open Two-factor authentication from the account menu. Your app and recovery codes are unchanged.

good_to_know: You are not signed in automatically after a reset.
The change does not alter your roles, client access or release permission.
Your authenticator app and recovery codes still work.

sections.title: State
paragraphs: Displays Your password is now changed in the entrance layout. There are no editable fields or dedicated Sign in button; use the application brand to return to the dashboard/sign-in journey. This deployment does not automatically sign in an account after reset. The change does not alter laboratory roles, client ownership, release permission or MFA.
